title: Design, Synthesis, and Hypoxia-Inducible Factor-1alpha Inhibitory Activity Evaluation of Panaxadiol Derivatives Containing a Thiazole Moiety.
authors: Ma, Xin-Yu; Li, Ming-Yue; Jin, Kai-Han; Han, Zhen-Yuan; Gao, Yuan-Liang; Jin, Xue-Jun; Zhao, Yu-Qing; Piao, Hu-Ri
one_liner_zh: 该文为小分子化合物合成与HIF-1α抑制活性评价，仅含分子对接且非蛋白-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha) pathway has been implicated in tumor angiogenesis, growth, and metastasis. Therefore, the inhibition of this pathway is an important therapeutic target for cancer. Thiazole derivatives have been reported to have diverse biological activities, especially in terms of anti-tumor. Consequently, we hypothesized that the introduction of a thiazole functional group in PD was likely to improve the biological potency. Here, three series of PD derivatives containing a thiazole moiety were synthesized, including (a) sulfonyl-containing thiazole derivatives (5 a-l), (b) urea-containing thiazole derivatives (7 a-i), and (c) thiourea-containing thiazole derivatives (9 a-i), and evaluated for HIF-1alpha inhibitory activity using a Hep3B cell-based luciferase reporter assay. The results showed that about 1/3 of the target compounds showed moderate or strong HIF-1alpha inhibitory activity, among which compounds 5 d and 7 b showed the strongest inhibitory activity with IC(50) values of 17.37 and 6.42 muM, respectively, and did not show any significant cytotoxicity. Western blot assay results indicated that these two compounds exhibited more potent inhibition, compared with panaxadiol, of the expression of HIF-1alpha protein in Hep3B cells at a concentration of 50 muM. Molecular docking experiments were also performed to investigate the structure-activity relationship. Compounds 5 d and 7 b can be used as leads for further study and development of novel antitumor drugs.
abstract_zh: 缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1alpha）通路已被证实与肿瘤血管生成、生长及转移相关。因此，抑制该通路是癌症治疗的重要靶点。噻唑衍生物已被报道具有多种生物活性，尤其在抗肿瘤方面表现突出。据此，我们假设在PD中引入噻唑官能团可能提升其生物效力。本研究合成了三个系列的含噻唑部分的PD衍生物，包括（a）含磺酰基的噻唑衍生物（5 a-l）、（b）含脲基的噻唑衍生物（7 a-i）及（c）含硫脲基的噻唑衍生物（9 a-i），并通过基于Hep3B细胞的荧光素酶报告基因实验评估其HIF-1alpha抑制活性。结果表明，约三分之一的靶化合物表现出中等或较强的HIF-1alpha抑制活性，其中化合物5 d和7 b显示出最强的抑制活性，其IC(50)值分别为17.37和6.42 μM，且未表现出显著细胞毒性。Western blot实验结果显示，在50 μM浓度下，这两种化合物对Hep3B细胞中HIF-1alpha蛋白表达的抑制作用强于人参二醇。此外，还进行了分子对接实验以探究构效关系。化合物5 d和7 b可作为进一步研究和开发新型抗肿瘤药物的先导化合物。
